title: accessPolicy 'space' without Chat capability has no error
description: Scene SceneRegion/set create accepts accessPolicy: 'space' as a valid value, but 'space' semantics require urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat. If a client writes accessPolicy: 'space' to a server without Chat capability, no error is specified — the region becomes effectively open with a confusing field value. The SetError table needs an entry for this case (e.g., invalidArguments when accessPolicy is 'space' but Chat capability is absent).
